dataList.content:
You returned to me after some time... and spoke strange things.
不知何时回来的你……对我说出了让人无法理解的话。

dataList.content:
Yi Sang. When Gubo comes back with that blue supplement... keep it stored instead of swallowing it right away.
李箱。当仇甫带着蓝色营养剂回来的时候……不要马上吞下去。把它们一粒一粒攒起来。

dataList.title:
Yeonsim
研心
dataList.content:
After around three days of doing so... you'll start seeing things you couldn't before.
这么做大概三天之后……许多你之前看不见的东西，就会开始显现出来。

dataList.title:
Yeonsim
研心
dataList.content:
When that day comes, you will have two options.
当那天到来的时候，你将会有两个选择。

dataList.title:
Yeonsim
研心
dataList.content:
The first is to chew up all the supplements you've gathered.
第一个选项，是一次性把攒下来的所有的营养剂都嚼碎吞下去。

dataList.title:
Yeonsim
研心
dataList.content:
It will put you into a deep sleep. But when you wake, everything will return to normalcy. You'll spend your days wholly dedicated to the mirror technology like this, chatting with me from time to time. The status quo will be preserved.
然后你会陷入沉睡。但是当你醒来时，一切都会恢复正常。你将一辈子致力于研究镜子技术，有时还会陪我聊聊天，维持现状。

dataList.title:
Yeonsim
研心
dataList.content:
The second... is to leave this place.
第二个选项是……离开这个地方。

I lack the wings to do so. How will I accomplish that?
我没有翅膀。我要如何离开？

dataList.title:
Yeonsim
研心
dataList.content:
A chicken may not be able to fly, but that doesn't stop it from flapping its wings.
一只鸡也许没法飞翔，但这并不会使它停止振翅。

dataList.title:
Yeonsim
研心
dataList.content:
It struggles... endlessly.
它会……挣扎不休。

You perplex me. At this point in time... where must I even go? I have neither a hometown nor an awaiter to return to.
你让我困惑。此时此刻……我到底应该去往何方？我既没有家乡，也没有人在等我归来了。

dataList.title:
Yeonsim
研心
dataList.content:
Be straightforward. If there is no hometown, you can walk ceaselessly until your feet decide to stop, and make that your new home.
想简单一点。如果不再有家乡，那就不停地走下去，并把脚步停止的地方当作新的家乡。

I followed your words and avoided taking the blue supplements.
遵照你的话，我没有服用蓝色营养剂。

Once I stopped taking the supplements, what had only been a blur carved a clear image onto my retina for the first time.
停止服用营养剂一段时间后，一直模糊不清的东西第一次清晰地印刻在了我的视网膜上。
dataList.place:
A Hallway in N Corp.
N公司的一条走廊

dataList.content:
The room I was in was not closed. It has always been open, and I had the freedom to go anywhere.
我的房间并不是封闭的。它一直都是开放的，而且我能自由进出。

Walking through the long and narrow hallway, I saw how my mirror was being used.
漫步在狭长的走廊上，我看到了我的镜子是如何被使用的。

Then, a sudden wave of lassitude began to surge.
这时，一股强烈的疲倦感向我袭来。

If I took the supplements and fell asleep, everything would have stayed alright.
如果我就这样吞下那些营养剂睡着了的话，一切都会好起来的。

And I wished to believe that there must have been a misunderstanding between Gubo and me.
我一直试图相信，仇甫和我之间只是有什么误会。

Alas...
但……

I stepped outside the white square and kept walking.
我走出了白色的四方形。
